Dear Vendor,

We are informing you that our systems will be undergoing a scheduled downtime from 2:00 PM to 4:00 PM UTC on Friday, October 20th. During this time, access to our platform will be unavailable.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding.

Best regards,
Larkspur Retail Support Team
